key.name: modifier-key
key.description: Only change the color temperature on scroll while this modifier key is held down. "none" means scrolling on the top bar always changes it.

key.name: invert-scroll
key.description: By default scrolling up makes the screen warmer and scrolling down makes it cooler (towards neutral). When set, the direction is reversed.

key.name: step
key.description: How many Kelvin to change the color temperature by on each scroll tick.

key.name: min-temperature
key.description: The lowest (warmest) color temperature in Kelvin that scrolling can reach. Neutral is 6500 K.

key.name: saved-state-valid
key.description: Internal. True while the extension has overridden Night Light and the saved-* keys hold the original values.

key.name: saved-active
key.summary: Night Light was active when overridden
key.description: Internal. Whether the user's own Night Light schedule was active when the extension took over.
